page_title: AI Voice Isolator, Extract Voice from Video

sources.entry: Remove Audio - Extracts clean dialogue or vocals from a video with an AI model that runs in the browser, so the file is not uploaded. #freemium

summary.name: AI Voice Isolator (Remove Audio)
summary.one_liner: A browser-based AI tool that extracts clean speech from a video or audio file, removing music, room noise and ambience, and can return the video with the picture untouched.
use_cases: Prepare audio for transcription or captions
Pull a clean quote from a video with a soundtrack
Dub or translate a video using a dialogue track
Rescue interview audio recorded in a noisy place
Turn a filmed conversation into a podcast episode
Isolate voices for research or accessibility review
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes a video or audio file and uses an AI model to separate the spoken voice from music, effects, ambience and room tone. On a computer, the 'This device' option runs the model in the browser with no upload and no account; the Cloud option runs the full model on the vendor's servers for longer files. For video input, it returns a video with the picture unchanged and the isolated speech as the audio. Users can preview the result before downloading it. The page recommends a separate background noise remover for wind, hum or chatter the model keeps.
notable: On-device processing in the browser: files are not uploaded when using This device mode
Returns video with picture untouched when a video is supplied
Cloud mode handles up to 5 GB per file and 6 hours of audio
Related tools on the site: AI Vocal Remover, Background Music Remover, Background Noise Remover
caveats: On-device mode needs a browser with WebGPU and at least 8 GB of memory, limited to 15 minutes per file (3 minutes and 50 MB on a phone or tablet), and some devices run a lighter model that separates less cleanly.
Cloud mode costs 1 credit per minute after the 10 free credits, and every started minute is billed.
Struggles with several people talking over each other, whispered speech under loud mix, and clipped or heavily distorted audio.
